observed: Starting state: the Browser pane tab held a leftover 'denied' consent value from an earlier run, so I ran localStorage.clear() on http://localhost:4180 and loaded the entry URL again; localStorage.getItem('oldhand-analytics-consent') === null was true. Step 1: !!document.querySelector('script[data-oldhand-analytics]') was false, no script src or Resource Timing entry contained googletagmanager (the pane's network log also showed none), window.gtag and window.dataLayer were undefined. Step 2: no position:fixed element existed, the only sticky element was the header (HEADER.top), 'Allow analytics' and 'No thanks' were absent from the page text, and there were 0 dialog elements. Step 3: the footer read 'Google Analytics is off; nothing is sent.' with a 'Turn on Google Analytics' button and a 'How Google uses data' link (to https://policies.google.com/technologies/partner-sites). I clicked the button with a real mouse click. Step 4: the footer read 'Google Analytics is on.' with a 'Turn it off' button; localStorage held 'granted'; script[data-oldhand-analytics] existed in <head> with src https://www.googletagmanager.com/gtag/js?id=G-75YW6HE9FT; Resource Timing listed that gtag/js request plus a www.google-analytics.com/g/collect beacon for tid G-75YW6HE9FT; window.gtag was a function and window.google_tag_manager had the key G-75YW6HE9FT. Step 5: after a fresh navigation and then a literal location.reload() (navigation type 'reload'), with no click, the script element was present again, localStorage was still 'granted', the gtag/js request was in Resource Timing, and the footer still read 'Google Analytics is on.' with 'Turn it off'. Step 6: I clicked 'Turn it off'; localStorage held 'denied' and the footer read 'Google Analytics is off; nothing is sent.' with the 'Turn on Google Analytics' button again. Extra: a reload after turning off showed no script element and no googletagmanager request (consent 'denied').
expected: Before the click: no analytics script element, no googletagmanager request, no overlay, footer 'Google Analytics is off; nothing is sent.' with a 'Turn on Google Analytics' button and a 'How Google uses data' link. After the click: script element with data-oldhand-analytics, a request to www.googletagmanager.com/gtag/js?id=G-75YW6HE9FT, localStorage 'granted', footer 'Google Analytics is on.' with a 'Turn it off' button. After reload: script element present again without a click. After turning off: localStorage 'denied' and footer 'Google Analytics is off; nothing is sent.' again.
